meta.title: ARM64 (AArch64) Assembly, Native Code & Compiler Output
meta.subtitle: Beginner → Expert Masterclass Roadmap
meta.completionMessage: Congratulations! You have completed the comprehensive ARM64 Assembly, Native Code & Compiler Output roadmap, mastering AArch64 registers, AAPCS64 calling conventions, SIMD/NEON instructions, C/C++ compiler output mapping, and low-level native reverse engineering!

details.title: General Purpose Registers
items: W0–W30 (32-bit lower-half views of X registers)
Zero Register: XZR (64-bit zero) / WZR (32-bit zero)

details.title: Special & System Registers
items: LR / X30 (Link Register — stores return address)
FP / X29 (Frame Pointer — base of stack frame)
NZCV (Condition Flags Register: Negative, Zero, Carry, oVerflow)
System Registers: Exception registers (ESR_EL1, FAR_EL1), Translation registers (TTBR0_EL1), Thread Pointer (TPIDR_EL0 for TLS)

details.title: Numeric & Bit Systems
items: Sign extension (UXTB, UXTH, SXTB, SXTH, SXTW)

details.title: Instruction Fields & Groups
items: Register specifier fields (5-bit fields for X0–X31)

details.title: Addressing Modes & Opcodes
items: Pre-indexed addressing ([Xn, #offset]! — update base before access)
Post-indexed addressing ([Xn], #offset — update base after access)

stages.title: Stage 7 — Data Movement
stages.subtitle: Load, Store, Move & Exclusive Pair Instructions

details.title: Data Movement Opcodes
items: MOV (Register copy) & MOVZ / MOVK / MOVN (Move immediate with keep/zero/not)
LDP / STP (Load Pair / Store Pair registers — critical for stack handling)
LDRB / LDRH / LDRSW (Load Byte / Halfword / Signed Word)
Exclusive Load/Store: LDXR / STXR, LDAXR / STLXR (Load-Acquire / Store-Release Exclusive)
Object reference loading, Constant loading & Pointer dereferencing

details.title: Math Opcodes
items: CMP (Compare: SUB without writing destination) & CMN (Compare Negative)
Floating-point arithmetic (FADD, FSUB, FMUL, FDIV, FCMP)

details.title: Logical Opcodes
items: AND (Bitwise AND) & ANDS (Bitwise AND updating flags)
ORR (Bitwise OR) & EOR (Bitwise Exclusive OR / XOR)
BIC (Bit Clear: AND with inverted mask)
TST (Test bits: ANDS without writing destination)
Bit masking, Flag evaluation & Boolean algebra implementation

stages.title: Stage 10 — Shift & Bit Instructions
stages.subtitle: Bit Shifts, Rotations & Intrinsic Bit Operations

details.title: Shift & Bit Manipulation Opcodes
items: LSL (Logical Shift Left) & LSR (Logical Shift Right)
CLZ (Count Leading Zeros) & CLS (Count Leading Sign bits)
Bit extraction (UBFX, SBFX) & Bit insertion (BFI, BFC)

stages.title: Stage 11 — Branch Instructions
stages.subtitle: Jumps, Link Calls, Returns & Conditional Test Branches

details.title: Branch Opcodes
items: BL (Branch with Link — stores return address in LR/X30)
BR (Branch to Register) & BLR (Branch with Link to Register)
CBZ (Compare and Branch if Zero) & CBNZ (Branch if Non-Zero)
TBZ (Test Bit and Branch if Zero) & TBNZ (Test Bit and Branch if Non-Zero)
Indirect branch execution & Branch jump tables

details.title: NZCV Bits & Condition Codes
items: GT (Signed Greater Than) & GE (Signed Greater or Equal)
LT (Signed Less Than) & LE (Signed Less or Equal)
HI (Unsigned Higher) & LS (Unsigned Lower or Same)
Conditional instruction execution (CSEL, CSINC, CSET, CSINV)

details.title: Stack Structure & Frame Conventions
items: Full descending stack model (Stack grows down toward lower addresses)
Frame Pointer (FP / X29) & Link Register (LR / X30) pairing
Function Prologue (STP X29, X30, [SP, #-N]! — allocating stack frame)
Function Epilogue (LDP X29, X30, [SP], #N; RET — tearing down frame)
Local variable storage layout in stack frames

details.title: AAPCS64 Standard Rules
items: Argument passing: X0–X7 for integer/pointer args; V0–V7 for SIMD/FP args
Return values: X0 (or X0–X1 for 128-bit); V0 for FP returns
Special registers: X18 (Platform register / TLS), X29 (FP), X30 (LR)
Structure passing rules (by value vs by reference)
Variadic function arguments passing on stack

details.title: SIMD / NEON Architecture
items: Register views: B (Byte), H (Halfword), S (Single), D (Double), Q (Quadword)
Packed vector arithmetic (FADD, FMLA, ADD, SUB on vector elements)
Vector load/store operations (LD1, ST1, LD4 multi-struct loads)

stages.title: Stage 16 — Memory Model
stages.subtitle: Weak Memory Ordering, Cache Lines & Barriers

details.title: Memory System Properties
items: Memory alignment rules & Unaligned access penalties
Page boundaries (4KB / 64KB pages) & Cache line sizes (typically 64 bytes)
Memory Barriers / Fences: DMB (Data Memory Barrier), DSB, ISB

details.title: Atomics & Synchronization Opcodes
items: Compare-And-Swap (CAS) instructions (CAS, CASA, CASL, CASAL in ARMv8.1+)
Atomic memory operations (LDADD, LDCLR, LDEOR, SWP)
Implementation of mutexes, spinlocks, and lock-free queues

stages.title: Stage 18 — Function Calls
stages.subtitle: Calling Pipelines, Frame Types & Tail Calls

details.title: Function Execution Sequence
items: Call Sequence: Argument preparation in X0–X7 → BL target_func
Parameter loading & Register preservation in prologue
Return sequence: Result in X0 → LDP X29, X30 → RET
Leaf functions (functions making no outbound calls — no LR stack push needed)
Non-leaf functions (functions saving LR/X30 to stack)
Tail-call elimination (B target_func instead of BL + RET)

details.title: Compiler Optimizations Recognition
items: Function inlining recognition (eliminating BL call frames)
Register allocation strategies (Graph coloring vs spilling)

stages.title: Stage 20 — C to Assembly Mapping
stages.subtitle: Translating Core C Constructs to ARM64 Opcodes

details.title: C Structure Mappings
items: Local & Global Variables → Stack offsets / ADRP + LDR
Pointers & Arrays → Base register + Index scaling
Structures & Unions → Offset-based LDR/STR pairs with padding
Loops (for, while, do-while) → CMP + B.cond / CBZ / TBNZ
Switch statements → Jump tables (BR) or CMP binary trees
Recursion → Stack frame pushes + BL self

details.title: C++ Feature Assemblies
items: Constructors & Destructors → Implicit this pointer (X0) calls
VTables & Virtual Dispatch → LDR vptr from [X0] → LDR func_ptr from [vptr, #offset] → BLR func_ptr
RTTI structures → Type descriptor pointers embedded in VTable -8
Exception handling → __cxa_throw calls & .ARM.extab / DWARF unwinding tables
Lambdas & Closures → Generated struct passed as this pointer
Move semantics (std::move) → Register re-assignment without deep copy

details.title: ELF Loading Subsystem
items: ELF program headers loading via linker (linker64)
Procedure Linkage Table (PLT) & Global Offset Table (GOT) resolution
Position Independent Code (PIC) & Position Independent Executables (PIE)

details.title: Essential System Binaries
items: bionic / libc.so, libdl.so, libm.so (Bionic C Library)

details.title: Compiler Idiom Identification
items: Switch lowering via jump tables (ADRP + LDR + ADD + BR)
Loop lowering (Do-while structure with conditional bottom branch)
Inline expansion of string/memory operations (memcpy -> STP pairs)
Constant multiplication using shifts and additions (LSL + ADD)
C++ Exception handling unwinding entry points
